stations.title: Order form
stations.text: Reads the clock, and nobody tests the times.

stations.title: Friday van
stations.text: Packed on Thursday, out on Friday.

captions: Bridget asks how an order placed after Wednesday's cut-off was promised this Friday.
The form reads the clock, so a test that runs today only checks today.
You set the clock in your tests, move it on, and put the real one back after each.
Now a late order goes out the Friday after, and a held basket is let go on time.
Same form, same clock. Your tests check any day and time without waiting for it.
